about.title: About this neighbourhood map
about.p1: This digital neighbourhood map was developed as part of early-years educator training (Lernfeld 5). Its goal is to make support systems in the neighbourhood visible and easily accessible for parents and early-years professionals.
about.p2: The placement site is at the centre of the map. The services shown were selected for their potential relevance to children, parents and families.
about.flowNote: Kita → parents → children → neighbourhood → support systems: the partnership between education and upbringing lives from everyone around the Kita working together.
about.sourceNote: This literature is the academic basis for the school assignment.

quellen.title: Sources
quellen.intro: An overview of all sources used for this neighbourhood map. No invented information – every address, every service and every distance comes from a publicly available source linked here.
quellen.mapDataOutro: Coordinates are geocoded from the researched addresses (street-level accuracy). Distances are real straight-line calculations from these coordinates – never invented values. "Open route" links go to Google Maps (plain web links, no API key).
quellen.institutionsNote: Priority: berlin.de → official service website → official provider → Familienportal Berlin. No Wikipedia as a primary source.
